value.text:
The Instituto Superior de Ciências da Educação do Huambo (ISCED-HBO) is a public higher-education institution based in the city of Huambo, Angola. Its area of activity is described as restricted to Huambo province. The institute has roots in the degree-course centre of Universidade Agostinho Neto that opened in Huambo in 1988. This centre formed part of the university’s network of educational-sciences institutes and was attached to the Centro Universitário do Huambo.

Operations were interrupted in the period of the Angolan Civil War after 1992 and resumed in 2001. During the decentralisation of Angolan higher education in 2008 and 2009, ISCED-HBO acquired full autonomy. This change took effect under decree-law No. 7/09 of 12 May 2009, approved by the Council of Ministers. Its predecessor origin and the later establishment of the autonomous institution therefore represent distinct stages of its history.

The teaching provision listed for 2018 included licenciatura courses in biology, physics, geography, history, Portuguese, English, mathematics, pedagogy, psychology and chemistry. The postgraduate listing included master’s provision in Education and Nature Conservation and Educational Sciences. An enrolment figure of 2,600 students is reported for 2015; it represents that historical observation rather than a current total.
